integrity: Reproducible analytic proof with exact-rational supporting checker; the checker verifies finite rational inequalities, not an infinite-domain theorem by enumeration. Novelty has unindexed literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Sufficient high-degree theorem for \(k\ge23\) and \(2k<p<2k+2\) only; no optimal threshold, no endpoint phase-rigidity, no other frequency patterns, no independent external validation.
title: Global coefficient-phase rigidity for high-order three-term majorants
